repository.preflight: Clean website checkout matched fetched origin/main. Reader source and unrelated untracked FN-45 metadata were left untouched. Private correspondence and Agent Comms were excluded.
repository.publication_action: Validated for pull-request publication of a semantic no-op. Production verification follows merge and is reported separately; this audit does not claim a future deployment.

cartographer.declared_question: How can shared intelligence make disagreement and common ground legible without manufacturing consensus?
cartographer.inquiry_basis: Existing Polis proposals REL-P-000001 and REL-P-000002 and exact Field Note 25.

sources_checked.attribution: The Computational Democracy Project, official Polis overview.
source_facts: The overview describes open-source survey technology using statistics and machine learning.
Participants submit statements and respond with agree, disagree, or pass.
Participants shape the inquiry and need not complete every response to contribute.
sources_checked.inference: Polis remains a useful neighbouring approach to group sensemaking, not an equivalent of FN-25's broader treatment of evidence, values, dissent, ratification, and unresolved questions.
sources_checked.uncertainty: Primary-document comparison only, not a fresh participant trial, facilitation assessment, or evaluation of reported social outcomes. No endorsement, partnership, or settled truth is implied.

cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The existing proposal pair already records both the shared question and the methodological difference. Another node or edge would duplicate it. Today's checked date is retained in this audit without rewriting historical source facts.
cartographer.handoff: Existing Polis queue and focused primary-source comparison handed to the Gardener.

reviewed: Current 12-node, 7-edge manifest and Polis proposal pair
Exact FN-25, FN-29, FN-32, BN-005, I-003, A-001, and the Kernel's verbs and laws
Catalog summaries, subjects, related paths, public-work status, and source evidence around collective sensemaking and the tending offices
retained_decisions: Keep a statistical opinion map distinct from proof of truth or the full representation of a person's position.
Keep consensus-oriented methods distinct from FN-25's permission for unresolved questions and explicit dissent.
Keep exact works distinct from situated curatorial interpretation and human ratification.
Keep a growing cumulative directory distinct from finite discovery and the three-item Attending selection.
Preserve historical office publications as dated sources while applying the active publication authority to this run.
gardener.decision_reason: The focused cross-form comparison found existing metadata and caveats adequate. No relation, lifecycle, evidence, or placement change was warranted. No relational-change essay or selection rotation was needed. Mechanical checks supplement this bounded semantic reading rather than imply a reading of every exact work.

The Librarian performed no outward search.
